title: A prompt-delivery test removes its failing persistence directory silently
outcome: A prompt-delivery test removes its failing persistence directory silently
acceptance: a_failed_requeue_commit_leaves_the_rejected_receipt_retryable (src/tests/prompt_delivery.rs) removes its failing directory with remove_test_directory, which names the path and the OS error on failure, instead of `let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&failing)`
